summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo, but nothing was executed (per instructions), so it is unverified by tests. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style to keep click metadata; docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py, CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; new tests in tests/widgets/test_tabs.py plus appended cases in test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py. Existing tests untouched. Judgment calls to review: bar position uses displayed-tab indices rather than find_tab_by_name's full-list index (differs only when a duplicate name precedes the active tab); Edge protocol already had min_size, so layout_resolve was not changed; zero-width label edges are excluded from the resolver and given zero cells. Unverified assumptions: rich 11 Style merge keeps meta on +, zero-length spans behavior, and Python 3.7 import compatibility (checked by reading only). No commits made.
